free_tier_limits.correction: A Free plan is available after ending a subscription or trial; it cannot post jobs or interact with candidates and can only view existing candidate data.

description.correction: Workable provides a REST API for retrieving jobs and account data and for managing candidates, employees, and recruiting workflows; current documentation does not describe creating or updating job postings through the API.

notes: The API is operational, but the submitted entry uses an obsolete-looking global v1 URL and the wrong authentication header. Current endpoints are account-subdomain-specific under /spi/v3. Workable also publishes a 10-per-10-seconds limit, explicitly does not support CORS, and documents a restricted Free plan.
